<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#F5F2E9;
    --surface:#F3F0E7;
    --ink:#1B2620;
    --muted:#5C665D;
    --olive:#4F5E43;
    --gold:#B4914A;
    --gold-deep:#96762f;
    --slate:#8C9FB2;
    --line:#A3AC9E;
    --font-display:"Songti SC","STSong","Noto Serif CJK SC","SimSun",Georgia,serif;
    --font-body:"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  html,body{width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:#F5F2E9;}
  .slide{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);
    font-family:var(--font-body);color:var(--ink);}

  /* ---------- background field ---------- */
  .bg-field{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:
    radial-gradient(1100px 780px at 0% 0%,rgba(180,145,74,.10),transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(880px 760px at 48% 50%,rgba(140,159,178,.09),transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(950px 760px at 100% 100%,rgba(79,94,67,.11),transparent 72%),
    linear-gradient(168deg,#F8F5EC 0%,#F5F2E9 52%,#EFECE1 100%);}
  .bg-field:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(27,38,32,.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 160px);}
  .hl{position:absolute;top:0;height:1080px;width:1px;z-index:1;background:rgba(27,38,32,.05);}
  .hl1{left:480px}.hl2{left:960px}.hl3{left:1440px}
  .dot-field{position:absolute;z-index:1;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,38,32,.45) 1.05px,transparent 1.15px);
    background-size:15px 15px;opacity:.2;left:1300px;top:58px;width:420px;height:74px;}
  .edge-prism{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:1876px;top:0;width:120px;height:1080px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(140,159,178,.20),rgba(140,159,178,.06) 70%,rgba(140,159,178,0));}

  /* ---------- frame ---------- */
  .top-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:48px;width:1760px;height:1px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.34);}
  .page-no{position:absolute;left:96px;top:22px;z-index:15;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:#657066;}
  .top-meta{position:absolute;right:96px;top:22px;z-index:15;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4.2px;color:#4f5b53;}
  .bottom-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:986px;width:1760px;height:1px;z-index:6;background:rgba(27,38,32,.22);}
  .foot-note{position:absolute;left:96px;top:1004px;z-index:15;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2.4px;color:#6b756c;}
  .page-count{position:absolute;right:96px;top:1002px;z-index:15;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#4f5b53;}

  /* ---------- left column ---------- */
  .kicker{position:absolute;left:96px;top:96px;z-index:12;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:7px;color:#7d857c;}
  .title{position:absolute;left:96px;top:126px;z-index:12;
    font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:96px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:8px;color:#1a231e;}
  .title-rule{position:absolute;left:96px;top:268px;width:560px;height:2px;z-index:12;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--olive) 0%,rgba(79,94,67,.15) 70%,rgba(79,94,67,0) 100%);}
  .lede{position:absolute;left:96px;top:290px;z-index:12;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--muted);}

  .block-label{position:absolute;left:96px;top:372px;z-index:12;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--gold-deep);}

  .kw{position:absolute;left:96px;width:600px;height:76px;z-index:12;display:flex;align-items:center;
    gap:26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .kw-b{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .kw-idx{width:32px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);}
  .kw-word{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:42px;letter-spacing:8px;color:#1f2823;}
  .kw-note{position:absolute;left:96px;top:648px;z-index:12;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#77817a;}

  .quote{position:absolute;left:96px;top:706px;width:620px;z-index:12;
    padding-left:30px;border-left:4px solid var(--gold);}
  .quote-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--olive);}
  .quote-text{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:58px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:3px;
    margin-top:14px;color:#1a231e;}
  .quote-sub{margin-top:12px;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#77817a;}

  /* ---------- divider ---------- */
  .col-divider{position:absolute;left:736px;top:150px;width:1px;height:836px;z-index:5;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(27,38,32,.02),rgba(27,38,32,.16) 30%,rgba(27,38,32,.16) 70%,rgba(27,38,32,.02));}

  /* ---------- cards ---------- */
  .card{position:absolute;left:800px;width:1024px;z-index:8;}
  .card-a{top:150px;height:330px;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.18);
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.62),rgba(243,240,231,.55));
    box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(27,38,32,.06);}
  .card-a:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:140px;height:3px;background:var(--olive);}
  .ca-label{position:absolute;left:40px;top:34px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--olive);}
  .ca-num{position:absolute;left:34px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;}
  .ca-num .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:168px;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-2px;color:#1a231e;}
  .ca-num .unit{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:40px;color:var(--muted);}
  .ca-cap{position:absolute;left:40px;top:262px;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#8a938b;}
  .ca-div{position:absolute;left:424px;top:44px;width:1px;height:242px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.14);}
  .ca-right{position:absolute;left:476px;top:92px;width:500px;}
  .ca-head{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:36px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:3px;color:#1f2823;}
  .chips{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:28px;}
  .chip{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2.4px;padding:9px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(79,94,67,.42);
    background:rgba(79,94,67,.07);color:var(--olive);border-radius:2px;}

  .card-b{top:520px;height:380px;border:1px dashed rgba(27,38,32,.32);
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(180,145,74,.10),rgba(180,145,74,.04));}
  .cb-label{position:absolute;left:40px;top:34px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--gold-deep);}
  .cb-text{position:absolute;left:40px;top:108px;width:700px;
    font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:40px;line-height:1.65;letter-spacing:2px;color:#1a231e;}
  .cb-note{position:absolute;left:40px;top:302px;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2.4px;color
